description: A shell script for configuring and managing a git-instaweb server, including starting, stopping, and restarting various web server backends (lighttpd, apache, webrick, python, plackup, mongoose). It sets up configuration files and server scripts for different HTTP servers to serve gitweb, with support for environment setup and process management.

methods.name: resolve_full_httpd
methods.description: Resolves the full path to the HTTP server executable based on configuration and environment.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts the configured HTTP server, managing process and configuration setup.

methods.name: stop_httpd
methods.description: Stops the running HTTP server process.

methods.name: httpd_is_ready
methods.description: Checks if the HTTP server is ready by attempting socket connection.

methods.name: gitweb_conf
methods.description: Generates the gitweb configuration Perl file.

methods.name: configure_httpd
methods.description: Configures the HTTP server based on the specified server type.
